text: According to Office of Management and Budget’s Circular A-4, transfer payments are monetary payments from one group to another that do not affect total resources available to society.  To the extent that fee revenue for TWIC enrollments are in excess of the Federal costs of administering the TWIC program, the difference between costs and revenue would be transfer payments.  For more information, visit: https://www.whitehouse.gov/sites/whitehouse.gov/files/omb/circulars/A4/a-4.pdf
